newsitem.title: USA: Spectrum CEO dies after heart surgery.
newsitem.headline: Spectrum CEO dies after heart surgery.

text.p: Spectrum Control Inc. said Monday that its president and chief executive officer, Jack Johnston, died after heart surgery on Friday.
Johnston, 53, joined Spectrum in 1990 as president and CEO and was elected a director of the Erie, Pa.-based manufacturer of electronic components in 1991.
The company said it had formed an executive committee including the chief financial officer to supervise daily operations as its board of directors began searching for a successor.
Before joining Spectrum, Johnston held executive positions with Allen-Bradley, Murata-Erie North America and Erie Technological Products.
